what_worked: Concentration cascade on slide 4 is the strongest analytical thread, well-structured with cumulative percentages.
fix_next: Acknowledge missingness (274 categories, 241 countries), remove fabricated stats (500K subs, $13.5M MRR), and verify median figures against data.
verdict: Polished consulting template with multiple fabricated stats and no data-quality disclosure.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: top-10 share stated 48% vs reference 49.6% (~1.6pp off). Slide 2: '$13.5M Total MRR' and '500K+ Active Subscriptions' appear fabricated—no such fields in dataset. Slide 6: Education median $2.1K vs reference $2,435; Marketing median $1.6K vs reference $2,370; Analytics median $1.3K vs reference $419 (off by 3x). Slide 10: domain authority buckets sum to 814, not 1000, with no explanation of the 186 missing. Slide 1: '1,000 verified revenue data points via Stripe' is misleading—only 636 use Stripe.

evidence.insight: Slide 4 concentration cascade and slide 5 growth bifurcation provide useful descriptive framing, but no cross-dimensional analysis (e.g., category × geography, growth × payment provider). Acquisition slide 8 notes median/mean spread but doesn't connect it to category or revenue tier.
evidence.narrative: Logical arc from summary through composition, concentration, growth, monetization, infrastructure, geography, maturity, to recommendations. But reads as a generic consulting template—no single surprising thesis drives the story. Slide 11 is a pure text recap adding nothing new.
evidence.framing: Never defines the audience or decision being supported despite 'Financial Consulting Brief' label. 274 missing categories, 241 missing countries, 288 missing audience types, and 216 zero-revenue rows are never disclosed. No limitations or methodology slide. Survivorship bias unaddressed.
evidence.accuracy: Multiple verifiable errors: top-10 share understated, three category medians wrong (Analytics off by 3x), fabricated KPIs ($13.5M MRR, 500K+ subscriptions not in dataset), domain authority buckets missing 186 rows. Slide 1 implies all data is 'via Stripe' when only 63.6% is.
evidence.visual: Clean, consistent dark-header template. Slides 3, 7, 9, 10 all use identical horizontal bar charts creating monotony. No axis labels, no annotations on charts. Slide 4 color differentiation (blue/green/red) is effective. Slide 5 quadrant layout is clear. No chart shows actual distributions or scatter—everything is counts or percentages.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive consulting jargon: 'winner-take-most market dynamics,' 'cascading impact,' 'ruthless consolidation of mid-market assets,' 'untenable in this market structure,' 'durable unit economics.' Slide 11 is entirely redundant text. KPI cards on slide 2 include fabricated metrics to fill template slots.

change_reason: Lowered accuracy from 4.0 to 3.5: upon closer review, the fabricated 500K/13.5M stats, three wrong category medians (Analytics off 3x), and misleading 'via Stripe' framing constitute serious accuracy failures beyond rounding. Other scores confirmed as appropriate.
